nom: Acne Free Terminator 10 Acne Spot Treatment With Benzoyl Peroxide 10% Maximum Strength Acne Cream Treatment

segments.sensitive: The one reviewer with sensitive skin reports it works well for her as long as she applies moisturizer first, since using it without that step dries her skin out.
segments.dry: The same reviewer with dry skin reports good results once she learned to pair it with a moisturizer beforehand, without which it dries her skin out.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers disagree on this point: two say it will dry out the skin with regular all-over use unless paired with a moisturizer applied first, while another long-term user reports it doesn't make her face feel dry at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including two describing persistent adult acne, report it clears breakouts effectively and better than pricier alternatives they've tried, though one reviewer reports it simply didn't work for her.

extraits.texte: I bought this product at Walmart and let me just say, be careful!!! It ruined $20 worth of towels for me. Oh, and it doesn't even work either. There are much better products out there that don't contain Benzoyl Peroxide.
Rather than receiving the product as ordered (Terminator Acne Treatment). We received lotions within the packaging. Too much hassle to send back.

I am 26 years old and still experience acne if I don't pay special attention to my skin every morning and evening. I have tried nearly everything, from prescription benzoyl peroxide to other chemicals and organic/natural treatments. This stuff is the best I've found, not just in its price range, but out of everything. It is head and shoulders above much more expensive options. A couple notes: - You can use this as a spot treatment or all over your face (I use it all over). - You can use this anywhere from once every other day to twice a day (I use it twice a day when breaking out and every other day when my skin is clear). - This WILL cause dryness if you use it regularly all over your face. Make sure you have a reliable moisturizer (a deep-penetrating night moisturizer and one with an SPF for daytime is best). - For best results (but also more dryness), you can pair with a toner or astringent.
